giveUp: Gave up. The screen did not change after 3 actions.

deadEnds: the screen did not change after 3 actions
device: GRIIT iPhone 16. Persona phone size was recorded and not applied, because this is the simulator that has the app installed.

interview.openTomorrow: Yeah, absolutely. I need to keep my streak going and see if I can climb higher on that leaderboard. That's the whole point.
interview.secured: It's when you complete all your tasks for the day - you 'secure' that day so it counts toward your streak. Basically, you locked in your win for the day.
interview.freeze: I'm guessing it's like a safety net? Maybe you can freeze one day so if you mess up, it doesn't break your streak. Something to protect your progress.
interview.selfReported: That's probably when you log your own completion instead of the app tracking it automatically. You manually report that you did the thing.
interview.best: Seeing my name climbing up that leaderboard. That's what I came for. Knowing I'm outperforming other people at this challenge - that's the rush.
interview.worst: Honestly, the app felt a bit slow loading everything, and I couldn't see all the details I wanted on the leaderboard rankings. Made it harder to see exactly how close the competition is.
interview.tellFriend: For sure. I'd be like 'Yo, there's this app GRIIT that tracks daily challenges and has a leaderboard. It's competitive - you compete against other people. If you're into self-improvement and like winning, you gotta check it out.'
